decision: Separate installed queue admission from worker startup: import installed compute_queue, call production_paths(), construct QueueService(home,script), call submit with exact unchanged workload argv and auto_start=False while idle; let that invocation finish and preserve its queued response; then start unchanged documented compute_queue.py worker CLI.
authority: Existing user authorization to complete experiments and necessary prerequisites, with no shared queue/frozen source edits. Root operational decision uses existing queue API rather than editing queue state or running a workload outside its worker.
operational_departure: README prescribes CLI submit; auto_start=False is an existing Python API, not a documented CLI flag. This narrowly changes admission orchestration to avoid ensure_worker startup polling. It is not a shared queue repair or claim of complete documented alternative workflow.
why: Repeated pre-acceptance worker_start_failed and denied state replacement. Source audit proves ensure_worker can probe/terminate a fresh worker or contend with its state update before acceptance. Actual lock owner for individual failures remains unknown.

controls: Use production_paths to bind exact installed queue/store; never copy or patch queue
Confirm no active queue jobs/workers/children/leases before admission
submit return is queued, not accepted or complete
Start documented worker only after admission process exits; normal worker lease, scheduling, execution and receipt publication remain active
No status/list/submit/doctor calls while workers or descendants live
Read live state with delete sharing only; no immediate polling
Worker exit zero is not job success; require official per-job status succeeded and integer0 after natural exit
Same release, full caps, stored order, limit4, preflight capacity and no explicit IDs for physical work
No automatic episode retries or changes to outcomes, source, readiness or seeds
Preserve and inspect each failure; resumable metadata finalization does not rerun experiments
limitations: Runner internal ordinary state readers and unrelated Windows readers can still deny replacement
Other projects may introduce concurrent contention
No claim that every Windows queue defect is repaired
